cards.mood: The piece opens with a serene, meditative atmosphere established by sparse instrumentation, evoking a sense of ancient stillness.
cards.palette: A solo bamboo flute (Dizi) serves as the primary melodic voice in the intro and interludes, characterized by its breathy, expressive tone and extensive use of vibrato and glissando.
